topic: E-130J technical-risk progression across GAO annual assessments
public_statement: GAO 2025 reports pre-development risks in systems integration, manufacturing, reliability/availability/maintainability, operational availability, and software/cybersecurity, based partly on a September 2024 independent technical risk assessment.
internal_content: GAO 2026 reports that integration risks had materialized, cites mission-system weight reduction, and says the low-rate production decision moved by approximately one year.
notes: This establishes a longitudinal GAO oversight narrative, not independent proof that every predicted risk caused each later schedule change.
